story.title: The Blue Beautiful Butterfly
paragraphs_en: I was sitting on my bed and watching butterflies from my window. They were fluttering their wings. Just then I saw something on the shutters. It looked like a bottle of medicine. There was a note beside it and it read " Drink This, Maximum Limit: 1.5 hour " . I didn't understand that. I thought it would just be something by my father, he is a scientist. I took no more time and drank it. Then after a minute I started getting wobbly and I shrunk to the size of the butterfly I was watching. I wanted to go out but the door was a little far as I was so small. Luckily, the window near me was open so I climbed it.

I thought I would just jump from the window, but when you are so small the world around you is so big. From the window it looked like I was going to fall from Burj Khalifa! I jumped and landed on a trash can. From there I jumped to the ground. There I saw a butterfly resting on the ground. I quickly jumped on the butterfly. It started flying and reached a flower. It started sucking nectar from the flower with her tongue, which functions like a straw for them to suck it. Then it moved away.

It went to her friends and I could hear them chatting. One said " Oh what a lovely day!" Another said " Let's go and find more flowers!" Then all of them started fluttering their wings and started flying. They left the garden and rose high in the sky. I was surprised by how they looked like but the climax was when the butterfly that I was sitting on made a loop. It felt like I was riding a roller coaster!

Then after a while they landed in an orchard. They were very happy because they found a lifelong supply of nectar. One said "Yay! Let's have a party to rejoice." Another said "Good idea! Then they started preparing for the party.

They had a party on a leaf and there was a runway from where they flew to the flower to get the nectar. They had a wonderful time and there was a butterfly who sang in the Butterfly language, "ButterFleasian". Then their party was over and they went to sleep in their new mansion made from leaves.

It started to get late and I had to get home. I was thinking of how to do that and then a paper plane flew towards me which was thrown by a child. Just then I got the idea! I jumped on it and I flew with it and reached my street! My home was just near so I walked carefully. The entrance to my home was closed but I was so small that I could pass from the little space beneath the door.

Suddenly there was a vibration in my body organs. My cells started to expand and I got back to my same height. I remembered that it said the maximum time was 1.5 hours. I was happy and looked for my father. I told him everything and said " That bottle of your potion you gave me was very nice". He replied. "What Potion? I didn't give you any." I was surprised and then said to my father "Wow!" "A mystery!"

Butterflies Butterflies have the typical four-stage insect life cycle. Winged adults lay eggs on the food plant on which their larvae, known as caterpillars, will feed. The caterpillars grow, sometimes very rapidly, and when fully developed, pupate in a chrysalis. When metamorphosis is complete, the pupal skin splits, the adult insect climbs out, and after its wings have expanded and dried, it flies off.
